comment_regular: Oblivion authoritative detection pipeline. Computes this detector's level against a target actor: obtains cached/physical LOS and distance, target light, boot weight, movement/running/sneak/combat/underwater/exterior state, Luck-modified Sneak values, detector Blindness AV 0x2D, target Chameleon AV 0x2E, and target Invisibility AV 0x2F; then calls Calc_DetectionLevel and updates the detector's process entry. Positive means detected. Fallout only corroborates the GetDetectionLevelAgainstActor terminology.
